item.title: WES BORLAND Says LIMP BIZKIT Has 'Ammo' For New Music As Seventh Studio Album Starts Taking Shape
item.description: Limp Bizkit appear to be back in the studio, putting fresh weight behind the possibility that the band’s long-discussed seventh studio album is finally moving forward. Recent photos and reports place Fred Durst, Wes Borland and other members working with producer Benjamin Grizzell in Nashville, just as the group enjoys one of the busiest periods of its career.

item.title: LIMP BIZKIT's WES BORLAND Cosplays As Skull-Faced JAMES HETFIELD At Metallica’s Denver Show
item.description: Limp Bizkit guitarist Wes Borland turned heads at Metallica’s Denver show on Friday by dressing up like a skull-faced version of 1980s James Hetfield (watch below). The look included a “Metal Up Your Ass” t-shirt and white high-top sneakers, all while performing a full 10-song set.

item.title: LIMP BIZKIT’s WES BORLAND’s Controversial Take on Heavy Metal: 'Boring As F*ck'
item.description: Wes Borland, guitarist for Limp Bizkit, has never exactly fit the mold of a typical nü-metal poster boy. Known for his elaborate stage costumes and artistic detours, Borland has always appeared slightly out of place next to Fred Durst’s red Yankees cap and the band’s frat-rap aggression.
